**True severity: Severity 2.** The customer reported P2. NS-Cloud shipment-exception alerts and route dashboards stopped at 2 of 6 depots (St. Louis and Memphis). Dispatchers were phoning drivers as a workaround, and the other depots were fine. The severity guide puts this in Severity 2: an alerting function was unavailable for some sites, NS-Cloud was unavailable to "some, but not all" sites, and the workaround needed ongoing manual effort. It is not Severity 1, because that needs "no workaround available" or NS-Cloud down for all users.

**Schedule version:** The ticket opened at 2026-08-20 19:45 CT, a Thursday. That falls under the version that applies from 2026-04-01. For Severity 2 it sets these targets:
- **Platinum:** 2-hour response and 12-hour restoration, on a 24×7 clock.
- **Silver:** 2 business-hour response and 12 business-hour restoration. Business hours are 08:00–18:00 CT, Monday to Friday, and there are no Northstar holidays on 21 or 24 August.

**Measurement:** No pauses or exclusions are recorded. The 19:46 automatic email doesn't count as a response. The first real response was an engineer's comment at 2026-08-21 10:20. Restoration was at 2026-08-24 10:40.

Credits are capped at 30% of the month's fee and are never applied automatically. Blue River emailed a claim on 2026-08-28. I didn't confirm the claim window, so I can't say whether that claim was on time.

**Who must be engaged or notified, and by when:** Due times depend on the plan, and I didn't confirm which escalation steps apply to Severity 2. Under each plan the deadlines would be:

| Duty | Who | Platinum (24×7) | Silver (business hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Engage as incident lead | Support Escalation Manager | 20:00 Thu 20 Aug | 08:15 Fri 21 Aug |
| Notify | Account owner, Kelly Floyd | 20:15 Thu 20 Aug | 08:30 Fri 21 Aug |
| Notify if no response by the response target | Support Escalation Manager | 21:45 Thu 20 Aug | 10:00 Fri 21 Aug |
| Notify if not restored at 50% of the restoration target | Director of Customer Support | 01:45 Fri 21 Aug | 14:00 Fri 21 Aug |
| Notify if not restored at 100% of the restoration target | VP Sales | 07:45 Fri 21 Aug | 10:00 Mon 24 Aug |

The Chief Revenue Officer isn't needed, because the account tier is Standard, not Strategic. Nothing in the knowledge base names the people holding these roles, except the account owner. Northstar also owes a decision on the claim, and a credit memo if a credit is owed.

**What the customer must do:** No phone report was needed, because the phone rule only matters for Severity 1. A claim was submitted on 2026-08-28; whether it was on time is unconfirmed.
